I have been busy with Aiki lately, and the last couple of days have been especially active. I return to my day job next week. I am a Computer Information Systems professor at Tarleton State University. So, I have been using the remaining summer window to close several related pieces of work.

The current state is tagged v0.4.0-alpha-26. I do not plan to create a GitHub Release for every such point. master moves as development continues; tags mark states worth stopping on.

The first public alpha already included most of the language proper: exact rational arithmetic, left-to-right evaluation, first-class functions, recursion and iteration, pipelines, shaped data, modules, recoverable errors, isolated concurrency, graphics, a standard library, semantic profiling, executable documentation, behavioral golds, grammar coverage, and a substantial invariant framework. Most of the work since then has not enlarged that surface very much. It has made the relationships underneath it considerably stricter.

Authority and the Grammar

The first substantial post-alpha work was on newline handling. grammar.ebnfx described the productions, but part of the actual surface rule still lived in parser code: whether a physical newline terminated a statement depended on a private completion set and delimiter-suppression logic. That policy now lives in the grammar. The parser consumes it, help exposes it, and structural analysis derives its consequences.

This exposed several useful facts about the existing language. Some tokens that initially looked like problematic continuations: (, [, and -, are actually resolved as beginnings of new expressions after termination. Other continuations are unambiguously blocked by the current rule. A function literal ending in } exposes another edge because } can end an expression without itself being part of the newline-completion set. I did not change those language choices merely to make the rule more symmetrical. They are now visible design questions rather than behavior hidden in parser code.

The same work tightened several grammar-sensitive relationships. Evaluator coverage is checked against the syntax the grammar can actually produce. Formatter coverage is explicit across the grammar rather than falling through silent recursion. Linter knowledge about syntax nodes is checked. Binary-operator membership comes from the grammar instead of a separate evaluator list. Newline help and related diagnostics derive from the declared policy.

A second pass then found that several consumers were independently walking the grammar to derive the same structural facts. Those derivations are now centralized in a cached grammar analysis. Production names, token references, AST-producing node types, terminal alternatives, and newline analysis are derived once and consumed where needed.

The working rule is straightforward: a fact should have one authority. Consumers may have their own policy and representation, but they should not independently reconstruct the same fact.

Tooling and Failure Semantics

The newline work introduced deliberately unparsable smoke specimens, which exposed some weaknesses in the surrounding tools. Negative parser specimens now declare themselves explicitly:

# @negative parse

The declaration is restricted to the test fixtures where it is meaningful. It cannot be used in ordinary source to exempt malformed code from formatting or linting.

Following that through uncovered several older problems. Recursive formatting could encounter malformed source, report it, and still fail to propagate the error correctly. Lint's formatting preflight could stop after the first malformed file. Several commands returned status codes internally that the top-level executable discarded, allowing a command to print failure and still exit successfully.

Those paths now propagate their status to the shell.

The fuller lint traversal also exposed a separate module-resolution drift. Runtime resolved public package names through the module registry, while lint maintained a filesystem approximation of that rule. Valid code using use("list") was enough to expose the disagreement once lint began reaching source it had previously skipped. Lint now uses the same registry model for public package resolution while retaining normal relative-path handling for path imports.

I followed the grammar project with a more general audit and began recording findings with stable identifiers and explicit dispositions. Some were fixed, some accepted, some deferred. Newline delimiter suppression, for example, now tracks expected closing delimiters rather than an aggregate depth that an unmatched closer could corrupt. The point of the ledger is not to turn every observation into work; it is to keep credible findings from disappearing when a project ends.

Distribution and Location Independence

Aiki had also accumulated an implicit assumption that the source tree was the installation.

That worked because the development executable normally lived beside lib/, but it meant runtime correctness was partly dependent on where the process happened to be started. The running executable now identifies its distribution. Shipped modules are found relative to that executable, user modules have an explicit home, and named package discovery does not recursively scan arbitrary trees beneath the current working directory.

The normal installation model is therefore just:

unpack Aiki
add the directory to PATH
run aiki

make dist constructs the user distribution. make distcheck goes further: it unpacks that distribution under a temporary prefix, runs from an unrelated directory, plants misleading package trees there, and verifies that the installed Aiki still resolves and runs its own modules correctly.

There is also a separate make baseline target for development snapshots. A baseline retains the repository, including .git, and is intended as a complete restartable development state. It is not the user distribution.

This distinction later became important again during self-hosting. Several things that worked from the repository root turned out to depend on being there.

An Independent Aiki Front End

The largest body of post-alpha work began with a question about self-description: how much of Aiki could be implemented independently in Aiki itself?

There is now an Aiki-written lexer, newline normalizer, and recursive-descent parser under selfhost/. They do not call the Go lexer or parser.

Independence does require duplication of some facts. A lexer has to know the keywords and operators it recognizes. A newline normalizer has to know the completion and suppression policy. Those duplicated facts are checked against values derived from grammar.ebnfx; the algorithms themselves remain independent.

The lexical and newline implementations are compared with the Go implementation against reviewed conformance projections. For parsing, I reused the existing grammar-shaped parse golds rather than inventing another expected-tree format. The result is a useful three-way relationship among grammar and reviewed evidence, the Go implementation, and the Aiki implementation.

This is different from simply adding more tests around the same implementation. The second front end has its own code and its own opportunities to be wrong.

Language Services

The editor work grew from the same concern about authority.

A parser, formatter, linter, editor extension, and LSP server can easily become several incomplete copies of the language. Rather than make the LSP server another owner of Aiki semantics, I moved reusable language knowledge into an editor-independent service layer.

That layer now provides document analysis, structured diagnostics, symbols, definition lookup, canonical formatting, completion, and hover information. aiki lsp is an adapter over that service rather than the service itself.

This has been exercised through three rather different editors. Xed uses its normal GtkSourceView mechanism for lexical presentation and a thin plugin for live diagnostics. VS Code uses a conventional thin language client and has been tested for diagnostics, completion, hover, Go to Definition, and Format Document. For nvi, Aiki generates ordinary tags:

aiki tags -o tags source.ai

and nvi uses them in the usual way.

The live editor tests were useful. Xed exposed Save-As document identity and the presentation of zero-width EOF diagnostics. VS Code exposed an invalid JSON-RPC null response and an assumption that definition requests would be positioned at the first byte of an identifier. Desktop-launched editors also demonstrated that their process environment cannot be inferred from an interactive shell's PATH.

Those were adapter problems, not invitations to move Aiki semantics into the adapters.

From Parser to Interpreter

The independent front end then grew into an interpreter.

Aiki now has an Aiki-written runtime environment and evaluator supporting lexical lookup, shadowing, assignment into enclosing scopes, closures, recursion, rest parameters, lists, shapes, indexing, field access, statements, control flow, pattern matching, pipelines, and returns.

This work exposed two gaps in the language surface.

The parser could read arbitrary symbol literals, but ordinary Aiki had no operation for constructing an arbitrary native symbol from a string. A self-hosted interpreter therefore could not faithfully turn a source lexeme into the corresponding value without either maintaining a finite private symbol table or introducing its own substitute representation. Neither was acceptable.

The result was:

to_symbol("foo")

which produces :foo.

Shaped values exposed a related boundary. The substrate already knew how to construct them, but ordinary Aiki did not. That became:

shaped(:point, [1, 2])

These are small additions to the language, but they came from a useful criterion: an implementation of Aiki written in Aiki should not need a private representation for values that ordinary Aiki source can express.

Modules and the HAL Boundary

Modules required a similar decision.

It would have been easy for the self-hosted evaluator to delegate import() back to the host interpreter, but that would also delegate source-module semantics to the implementation being checked. The self-hosted path therefore performs Aiki-source module loading itself:

resolve
read
lex
normalize
parse
evaluate
collect exports
cache

Platform facilities remain host capabilities. A privileged bootstrap captures the HAL functions needed by blessed library modules and installs them into the interpreted library environment without exposing those raw bindings to ordinary callers.

The distinction is intentional. Aiki source semantics can be implemented in Aiki. File access, clocks, graphics, native regex, and other platform effects still have to come from the substrate.

Behavioral Conformance

Running existing behavior specimens through the independent evaluator found a semantic mistake that the more focused evaluator tests had missed.

Aiki recoverable errors such as:

[@error, :math, "division by zero"]

are ordinary values. They can be bound, returned, inspected, and matched.

The self-hosted evaluator initially used is_error() to recognize its own internal failures, thereby conflating a recoverable Aiki value with an evaluator halt. The interpreter now uses a separate private fault representation for its own control path, leaving [@error, ...] values recoverable.

The behavior-conformance work now covers representative arithmetic, closures and recursion, matching, pipelines, relative imports, strings, file effects, pure and HAL-backed modules, bytes, hashes, regex behavior, and other existing language specimens. Concurrency, graphics, debugger-only cases, and interactive I/O remain outside the present self-host proof rather than being silently counted as covered.

Recursive Self-Interpretation

The eventual target was to run an Aiki-written interpreter through itself.

The first attempts appeared to spend most of their time parsing the inner parser, which suggested that recursive-descent parsing under a tree-walking interpreter was the main problem. Semantic profiling showed otherwise. A large part of the cost was in the independent lexer's character handling: repeated string indexing caused repeated rune materialization over large source strings.

string.chars now has a linear substrate realization, and the self-host lexer snapshots the source once and avoids some repeated table scans and position work. That reduced the measured workload enough to expose the next problems.

Those were module problems rather than parser problems. Path fallback in the independent loader did not quite match the host loader. Different paths involving . and .. could name the same physical module but become separate cache entries. Running recursively from outside the repository then exposed a further assumption: the self-hosted loader needed access to the same ordered distribution module roots as the host loader.

Those were corrected without handing the inner parser or evaluator back to Go.

The resulting path now works:

Go-hosted Aiki
    -> Aiki-written interpreter
        -> self-host-loaded Aiki interpreter
            -> 1 + 2 * 3
                -> 9

The result is 9 because ordinary Aiki binary expressions are evaluated left to right: (1 + 2) * 3. The same visible semantic rule survives at the third level.

Go remains the production runtime and bootstrap substrate. The self-host implementation is a second implementation and conformance boundary, not an attempt to pretend that the underlying machine or host runtime has disappeared.

Profiling the Profiler

Semantic profiling was already present in the first alpha. During the self-hosting work it became useful enough that the measurements themselves deserved scrutiny.

The recursive profiles are large. Rather than accept them because they looked plausible, I built a calibration experiment beginning with work whose semantic counts can be read directly from a few lines of Aiki.

The first programs put:

1 + 1

inside one, two, three, and four nested loops of ten. The leaf calculation therefore executes 10, 100, 1,000, and 10,000 times. The total completed loop-body iterations are 10, 110, 1,110, and 11,110. The profiler reports those counts exactly.

Arithmetic is equally direct. Each leaf contributes one addition and each loop-body iteration increments one loop variable, so the expected arithmetic counts are 20, 210, 2,110, and 21,110. Those counts are exact as well. The observed comparison sequence: 11, 121, 1,221, and 12,221, is also exactly what follows from testing each loop condition once more than its body executes.

A simpler expression:

1 + 2 + 3 + 4

contains three arithmetic operations; the profiler reports three.

A conventional loop:

while i < N {
    x = x + 1
    i = i + 1
}

has the directly predictable relationships:

arithmetic = 2N
comparison = N + 1
iteration  = N

For N equal to 10, 100, and 1,000, the observed counts match all three relationships exactly.

The experiment then moves into self-interpretation. With one Aiki-written interpreter loaded, one additional evaluation contributes:

arithmetic       958
comparison      1,082
call            3,255
iteration         832
index             935

Two evaluations add exactly twice that work, and four add exactly four times that work.

At the next interpreter level the fixed baseline is already large:

arithmetic       689,681
comparison     1,346,671
call           5,021,109
iteration        498,039
index            793,179

One additional third-level evaluation then adds:

arithmetic      +353,930
comparison      +388,932
call          +2,342,216
iteration       +304,091
index           +397,156

and the next identical evaluation adds exactly the same vector.

I ran the complete experiment twice. Every semantic counter was reproduced exactly across the two runs, including the native, one-level, and two-level self-host cases. The Go realization figures: elapsed time, cumulative allocation traffic, malloc count, and garbage-collection cycles, varied modestly, as expected.

The distinction is important. The semantic counters describe Aiki-level work. The Go measurements describe a particular realization of that work by the runtime and machine.

The calibration therefore connects programs countable by inspection with recursive interpretation involving millions of semantic events. Large recursive profiler counts are not being accepted merely because they have plausible scale; they are produced by the same instrumentation that is exact on small source and additive under repeated interpreted work.

Experiments Are Not Tests

That calibration became Experiment 001 and, in the process, exposed the need for another kind of project artifact.

Tests and experiments answer different questions. A test normally states a relationship the implementation is required to preserve. An experiment records a procedure, an observation, and an interpretation without turning the observation into a correctness gold.

Aiki experiments therefore have a simple structure:

001-profiler-calibration/
    README.md

    experiment/
        PROCEDURE.md
        run.sh
        materials...

    results/
        observations...

    analyses/
        interpretations...

The root orients the reader. experiment/ records the procedure and its materials. results/ contains what happened. analyses/ contains what I think the observations mean.

New work can be scaffolded outside the source tree with:

aiki experiment new "name"

The running distribution supplies the sequence number from its curated experiments/ collection, while the experiment itself is created in the caller's current directory. Finished work can then be promoted into the repository.

The distinction among procedure, observation, and interpretation is useful enough that I expect experiments to become a regular part of Aiki development.

The Commitments

None of this changes the original commitments of the project.

I still want Aiki to have a small surface and to make computational relationships visible enough to apprehend rather than merely execute. I still prefer direct composition over hidden machinery. The implementation still does not define the language merely by existing.

The extensive use of generative AI in the implementation makes this more important rather than less. The response is not to obscure that AI produced source code. It is to make the resulting source increasingly answerable to authorities and evidence outside itself.

The grammar owns syntax facts. Reviewed behavior constrains semantics. Executable documentation constrains examples. The language surface constrains implementation choices. Independent implementations can be compared. Editor clients exercise the service boundary. Relocated distributions test assumptions about location. Experiments retain their observations beside the procedure that produced them.

The direction is toward fewer places where an implementation assumption can quietly become a language fact.

Platforms

Linux remains Aiki's development home. That is where it is built, changed, and exercised continuously.

Intel macOS is periodically put through the more rigorous build and validation path rather than being assumed portable merely because it compiles. Windows is also run periodically and remains part of the portability work, although neither platform receives the continuous development attention that Linux does.

Aiki is cross-platform alpha software, developed primarily on Linux.

Pending Work

The authority work made several unresolved language questions easier to see. Newline behavior still has intentionally deferred edges, including the treatment of some leading continuations and the special case around function-literal endings. Those are now explicit language-design questions rather than accidental parser rules.

The language-service architecture is also deliberately incomplete. Incremental parsing, workspace-wide indexing, semantic tokens, rename/refactoring, and similar facilities are possible extensions, but they are not requirements merely because LSP has names for them. I would rather add them when actual use shows where the simpler model is inadequate.

Spawned abnormal termination needs further thought as well. Aiki's concurrency model makes isolation and message passing explicit; failure of spawned computations should have equally explicit observable semantics rather than becoming a leak from the Go substrate.

The broader project record now distinguishes proposals, audit findings, design decisions, experiments, bugs, and implementation sessions. I expect to continue using those distinctions rather than turning every open question into an implementation task.

Future Direction

The architectural direction is to continue tightening responsibilities and authorities: make each fact, capability, and policy belong somewhere definite; derive rather than duplicate where possible; and make important relationships executable.

The next capability work is likely to concentrate on the systems substrate.

Process Execution

I expect to start with process execution. A useful interface needs to launch a program with arguments, standard input, environment, and working directory, and return standard output, standard error, and exit status.

The host operation is narrow and belongs below the HAL boundary. Process orchestration belongs in Aiki. This is a small addition with a large practical effect because it allows Aiki programs to compose ordinary system tools.

Networking

TCP requires a similarly small host surface: listen, accept, connect, read, write, and close.

Aiki already has isolated spawn, channels, and message passing. A concurrent server should be constructed by composing those facilities with networking rather than by adding a separate server model.

JSON

JSON should be largely an Aiki library. The self-host lexer has already demonstrated character-level scanning, and Aiki values map reasonably well onto JSON values. A parser and emitter written in Aiki would be another useful test of where the HAL boundary belongs.

Operating-System Surface

A systems environment also needs ordinary process facts: arguments, environment variables, current directory, directory change, exit status, process ID, hostname, and related information.

I expect these to be a collection of small HAL capabilities behind an Aiki os module rather than additions scattered through the prelude.

Signals

Signal handling has to fit the concurrency model. My present direction is for signals such as SIGINT and SIGTERM to arrive as channel events, allowing ordinary message passing and select to coordinate them instead of introducing an unrelated asynchronous control mechanism.

Timers

Wall-clock time, elapsed time, and sleeping are straightforward host facilities. Timed coordination should compose with concurrency; time.after naturally fits the existing select design.

Cryptographic Hashing

SHA-256 and HMAC are another relatively clean boundary and become useful once programs begin dealing with integrity or authentication.

Across these additions the question remains the same: what is the smallest thing the host must provide, and what can Aiki construct from it?

Aiki at v0.4.0-alpha-26

Much of the work since the first alpha is architectural rather than immediately visible at the prompt. The following is a compact inventory of the tagged system.

Language

  • exact rational arithmetic;
  • left-to-right ordinary binary evaluation;
  • numbers, booleans, runes, strings, symbols, lists, and first-class functions;
  • functions, closures, recursion, rest parameters, iteration, and pipelines;
  • pattern matching;
  • shaped list data and named fields;
  • recoverable error values;
  • modules and explicit imports;
  • isolated spawn-based concurrency and channels;
  • graphics, canvas, and turtle facilities.

Language Authority and Description

  • declarative grammar owning the syntax surface;
  • grammar-owned newline termination and suppression policy;
  • centralized cached structural grammar analysis;
  • grammar/evaluator coupling;
  • grammar/formatter coupling;
  • checked linter syntax knowledge;
  • grammar-derived binary-operator membership;
  • grammar-backed syntax help;
  • reviewed structural parse projections;
  • executable documentation.

Implementations

  • production Go-hosted interpreter;
  • independent Aiki-written lexer;
  • independent Aiki-written newline normalizer;
  • independent Aiki-written recursive-descent parser;
  • Aiki-written runtime environment;
  • Aiki-written evaluator;
  • self-hosted Aiki-source module resolution, loading, exports, and caching;
  • scoped bootstrap bridge for HAL capabilities;
  • recursive self-interpretation through a third-level Aiki program.

Language Services and Editors

  • editor-independent document analysis;
  • structured diagnostics;
  • symbol discovery and definition lookup;
  • canonical formatting;
  • completion;
  • hover from source definitions and authored help;
  • language-service observation and instrumentation;
  • aiki lsp;
  • Xed syntax and live diagnostics;
  • VS Code diagnostics, completion, hover, definition, and formatting;
  • classic aiki tags generation for nvi and other tags consumers.

Modules and Platform Boundary

  • standard Aiki module library;
  • pure Aiki and HAL-backed modules;
  • explicit distribution module roots;
  • user library support;
  • explicit relative imports;
  • relocatable distribution lookup;
  • dynamic symbol construction with to_symbol;
  • general shaped-value construction with shaped.

Validation and Conformance

  • Go tests;
  • Aiki-native tests;
  • behavioral smokes;
  • reviewed gold files;
  • executable documentation;
  • grammar-production coverage;
  • structural engine golds;
  • formatter parse-preservation checks;
  • lint;
  • tree integrity checking;
  • fuzz tests;
  • property tests;
  • explicit negative-test declarations;
  • cross-implementation lexer, newline, parser, and behavioral conformance;
  • recursive self-interpretation invariants.

Profiling and Experiments

  • deterministic Aiki-level semantic counters;
  • source attribution;
  • Go runtime-realization measurements;
  • recursive self-host profiling;
  • empirical profiler calibration;
  • numbered reproducible experiment homes;
  • separate procedure, raw results, and analyses;
  • Experiment 001, profiler calibration.

Distribution and Development

  • make validate;
  • make dist;
  • make distcheck;
  • restartable repository baselines;
  • relocatable user distributions;
  • structural checking of distributed artifacts;
  • proposals;
  • audit findings;
  • recorded design decisions;
  • in-repository AI engineering provenance and restart records.

Where This Leaves Aiki

The first public alpha established that Aiki had become a usable small language. Milestone 26 is less about adding another layer of surface features than about making more of the system accountable to explicit relationships.

The grammar now owns more of the syntax it describes. Several formerly duplicated facts have identifiable authorities. The editor integrations consume common language services. A second implementation now covers the front end, evaluator, and module path. Aiki can run that implementation recursively. Distribution and self-hosting have both been exercised away from the source-tree environment that originally sheltered them. The profiler has been calibrated from directly countable programs through recursive interpretation.

There is plenty left to do, but this is a useful state to mark.

Development continues on master; v0.4.0-alpha-26 is the milestone.

  • First Public Alpha

A privileged bootstrap captures the HAL functions needed by blessed library modules and installs them into the interpreted library environment without exposing those raw bindings to ordinary callers. The distinction is intentional. Aiki source semantics can be implemented in Aiki. File access, clocks, graphics, native regex, and other platform effects still have to come from the substrate. Behavioral Conformance Running existing behavior specimens through the independent evaluator found a semantic mistake that the more focused evaluator tests had missed. Aiki recoverable errors such as: [@error, :math, "division by zero"] are ordinary values. They can be bound, returned, inspected, and matched. The self-hosted evaluator initially used is_error() to recognize its own internal failures, thereby conflating a recoverable Aiki value with an evaluator halt. The interpreter now uses a separate private fault representation for its own control path, leaving [@error, ...] values recoverable. The behavior-conformance work now covers representative arithmetic, closures and recursion, matching, pipelines, relative imports, strings, file effects, pure and HAL-backed modules, bytes, hashes, regex behavior, and other existing language specimens. Concurrency, graphics, debugger-only cases, and interactive I/O remain outside the present self-host proof rather than being silently counted as covered. Recursive Self-Interpretation The eventual target was to run an Aiki-written interpreter through itself. The first attempts appeared to spend most of their time parsing the inner parser, which suggested that recursive-descent parsing under a tree-walking interpreter was the main problem. Semantic profiling showed otherwise. A large part of the cost was in the independent lexer's character handling: repeated string indexing caused repeated rune materialization over large source strings. string.chars now has a linear substrate realization, and the self-host lexer snapshots the source once and avoids some repeated table scans and position work. That reduced the measured workload enough to expose the next problems. Those were module problems rather than parser problems. Path fallback in the independent loader did not quite match the host loader. Different paths involving . and .. could name the same physical module but become separate cache entries. Running recursively from outside the repository then exposed a further assumption: the self-hosted loader needed access to the same ordered distribution module roots as the host loader. Those were corrected without handing the inner parser or evaluator back to Go. The resulting path now works: Go-hosted Aiki -> Aiki-written interpreter -> self-host-loaded Aiki interpreter -> 1 + 2 * 3 -> 9 The result is 9 because ordinary Aiki binary expressions are evaluated left to right: (1 + 2) * 3. The same visible semantic rule survives at the third level. Go remains the production runtime and bootstrap substrate. The self-host implementation is a second implementation and conformance boundary, not an attempt to pretend that the underlying machine or host runtime has disappeared. Profiling the Profiler Semantic profiling was already present in the first alpha. During the self-hosting work it became useful enough that the measurements themselves deserved scrutiny. The recursive profiles are large. Rather than accept them because they looked plausible, I built a calibration experiment beginning with work whose semantic counts can be read directly from a few lines of Aiki. The first programs put: 1 + 1 inside one, two, three, and four nested loops of ten. The leaf calculation therefore executes 10, 100, 1,000, and 10,000 times. The total completed loop-body iterations are 10, 110, 1,110, and 11,110. The profiler reports those counts exactly. Arithmetic is equally direct. Each leaf contributes one addition and each loop-body iteration increments one loop variable, so the expected arithmetic counts are 20, 210, 2,110, and 21,110. Those counts are exact as well. The observed comparison sequence: 11, 121, 1,221, and 12,221, is also exactly what follows from testing each loop condition once more than its body executes. A simpler expression: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 contains three arithmetic operations; the profiler reports three. A conventional loop: while i < N { x = x + 1 i = i + 1 } has the directly predictable relationships: arithmetic = 2N comparison = N + 1 iteration = N For N equal to 10, 100, and 1,000, the observed counts match all three relationships exactly. The experiment then moves into self-interpretation. With one Aiki-written interpreter loaded, one additional evaluation contributes: arithmetic 958 comparison 1,082 call 3,255 iteration 832 index 935 Two evaluations add exactly twice that work, and four add exactly four times that work. At the next interpreter level the fixed baseline is already large: arithmetic 689,681 comparison 1,346,671 call 5,021,109 iteration 498,039 index 793,179 One additional third-level evaluation then adds: arithmetic +353,930 comparison +388,932 call +2,342,216 iteration +304,091 index +397,156 and the next identical evaluation adds exactly the same vector. I ran the complete experiment twice. Every semantic counter was reproduced exactly across the two runs, including the native, one-level, and two-level self-host cases. The Go realization figures: elapsed time, cumulative allocation traffic, malloc count, and garbage-collection cycles, varied modestly, as expected. The distinction is important. The semantic counters describe Aiki-level work. The Go measurements describe a particular realization of that work by the runtime and machine. The calibration therefore connects programs countable by inspection with recursive interpretation involving millions of semantic events. Large recursive profiler counts are not being accepted merely because they have plausible scale; they are produced by the same instrumentation that is exact on small source and additive under repeated interpreted work. Experiments Are Not Tests That calibration became Experiment 001 and, in the process, exposed the need for another kind of project artifact. Tests and experiments answer different questions. A test normally states a relationship the implementation is required to preserve. An experiment records a procedure, an observation, and an interpretation without turning the observation into a correctness gold. Aiki experiments therefore have a simple structure: 001-profiler-calibration/ README.md experiment/ PROCEDURE.md run.sh materials... results/ observations... analyses/ interpretations... The root orients the reader. experiment/ records the procedure and its materials. results/ contains what happened. analyses/ contains what I think the observations mean. New work can be scaffolded outside the source tree with: aiki experiment new "name" The running distribution supplies the sequence number from its curated experiments/ collection, while the experiment itself is created in the caller's current directory. Finished work can then be promoted into the repository. The distinction among procedure, observation, and interpretation is useful enough that I expect experiments to become a regular part of Aiki development. The Commitments None of this changes the original commitments of the project. I still want Aiki to have a small surface and to make computational relationships visible enough to apprehend rather than merely execute. I still prefer direct composition over hidden machinery. The implementation still does not define the language merely by existing. The extensive use of generative AI in the implementation makes this more important rather than less. The response is not to obscure that AI produced source code. It is to make the resulting source increasingly answerable to authorities and evidence outside itself. The grammar owns syntax facts. Reviewed behavior constrains semantics. Executable documentation constrains examples. The language surface constrains implementation choices. Independent implementations can be compared. Editor clients exercise the service boundary. Relocated distributions test assumptions about location. Experiments retain their observations beside the procedure that produced them. The direction is toward fewer places where an implementation assumption can quietly become a language fact. Platforms Linux remains Aiki's development home. That is where it is built, changed, and exercised continuously. Intel macOS is periodically put through the more rigorous build and validation path rather than being assumed portable merely because it compiles. Windows is also run periodically and remains part of the portability work, although neither platform receives the continuous development attention that Linux does. Aiki is cross-platform alpha software, developed primarily on Linux. Pending Work The authority work made several unresolved language questions easier to see. Newline behavior still has intentionally deferred edges, including the treatment of some leading continuations and the special case around function-literal endings. Those are now explicit language-design questions rather than accidental parser rules. The language-service architecture is also deliberately incomplete. Incremental parsing, workspace-wide indexing, semantic tokens, rename/refactoring, and similar facilities are possible extensions, but they are not requirements merely because LSP has names for them. I would rather add them when actual use shows where the simpler model is inadequate. Spawned abnormal termination needs further thought as well. Aiki's concurrency model makes isolation and message passing explicit; failure of spawned computations should have equally explicit observable semantics rather than becoming a leak from the Go substrate. The broader project record now distinguishes proposals, audit findings, design decisions, experiments, bugs, and implementation sessions. I expect to continue using those distinctions rather than turning every open question into an implementation task. Future Direction The architectural direction is to continue tightening responsibilities and authorities: make each fact, capability, and policy belong somewhere definite; derive rather than duplicate where possible; and make important relationships executable. The next capability work is likely to concentrate on the systems substrate. Process Execution I expect to start with process execution. A useful interface needs to launch a program with arguments, standard input, environment, and working directory, and return standard output, standard error, and exit status. The host operation is narrow and belongs below the HAL boundary. Process orchestration belongs in Aiki. This is a small addition with a large practical effect because it allows Aiki programs to compose ordinary system tools. Networking TCP requires a similarly small host surface: listen, accept, connect, read, write, and close. Aiki already has isolated spawn, channels, and message passing. A concurrent server should be constructed by composing those facilities with networking rather than by adding a separate server model. JSON JSON should be largely an Aiki library. The self-host lexer has already demonstrated character-level scanning, and Aiki values map reasonably well onto JSON values. A parser and emitter written in Aiki would be another useful test of where the HAL boundary belongs. Operating-System Surface A systems environment also needs ordinary process facts: arguments, environment variables, current directory, directory change, exit status, process ID, hostname, and related information. I expect these to be a collection of small HAL capabilities behind an Aiki os module rather than additions scattered through the prelude. Signals Signal handling has to fit the concurrency model. My present direction is for signals such as SIGINT and SIGTERM to arrive as channel events, allowing ordinary message passing and select to coordinate them instead of introducing an unrelated asynchronous control mechanism. Timers Wall-clock time, elapsed time, and sleeping are straightforward host facilities. Timed coordination should compose with concurrency; time.after naturally fits the existing select design. Cryptographic Hashing SHA-256 and HMAC are another relatively clean boundary and become useful once programs begin dealing with integrity or authentication. Across these additions the question remains the same: what is the smallest thing the host must provide, and what can Aiki construct from it? Aiki at v0.4.0-alpha-26 Much of the work since the first alpha is architectural rather than immediately visible at the prompt. The following is a compact inventory of the tagged system. Language exact rational arithmetic; left-to-right ordinary binary evaluation; numbers, booleans, runes, strings, symbols, lists, and first-class functions; functions, closures, recursion, rest parameters, iteration, and pipelines; pattern matching; shaped list data and named fields; recoverable error values; modules and explicit imports; isolated spawn-based concurrency and channels; graphics, canvas, and turtle facilities. Language Authority and Description declarative grammar owning the syntax surface; grammar-owned newline termination and suppression policy; centralized cached structural grammar analysis; grammar/evaluator coupling; grammar/formatter coupling; checked linter syntax knowledge; grammar-derived binary-operator membership; grammar-backed syntax help; reviewed structural parse projections; executable documentation. Implementations production Go-hosted interpreter; independent Aiki-written lexer; independent Aiki-written newline normalizer; independent Aiki-written recursive-descent parser; Aiki-written runtime environment; Aiki-written evaluator; self-hosted Aiki-source module resolution, loading, exports, and caching; scoped bootstrap bridge for HAL capabilities; recursive self-interpretation through a third-level Aiki program. Language Services and Editors editor-independent document analysis; structured diagnostics; symbol discovery and definition lookup; canonical formatting; completion; hover from source definitions and authored help; language-service observation and instrumentation; aiki lsp; Xed syntax and live diagnostics; VS Code diagnostics, completion, hover, definition, and formatting; classic aiki tags generation for nvi and other tags consumers. Modules and Platform Boundary standard Aiki module library; pure Aiki and HAL-backed modules; explicit distribution module roots; user library support; explicit relative imports; relocatable distribution lookup; dynamic symbol construction with to_symbol; general shaped-value construction with shaped. Validation and Conformance Go tests; Aiki-native tests; behavioral smokes; reviewed gold files; executable documentation; grammar-production coverage; structural engine golds; formatter parse-preservation checks; lint; tree integrity checking; fuzz tests; property tests; explicit negative-test declarations; cross-implementation lexer, newline, parser, and behavioral conformance; recursive self-interpretation invariants. Profiling and Experiments deterministic Aiki-level semantic counters; source attribution; Go runtime-realization measurements; recursive self-host profiling; empirical profiler calibration; numbered reproducible experiment homes; separate procedure, raw results, and analyses; Experiment 001, profiler calibration. Distribution and Development make validate; make dist; make distcheck; restartable repository baselines; relocatable user distributions; structural checking of distributed artifacts; proposals; audit findings; recorded design decisions; in-repository AI engineering provenance and restart records. Where This Leaves Aiki The first public alpha established that Aiki had become a usable small language. Milestone 26 is less about adding another layer of surface features than about making more of the system accountable to explicit relationships. The grammar now owns more of the syntax it describes. Several formerly duplicated facts have identifiable authorities. The editor integrations consume common language services. A second implementation now covers the front end, evaluator, and module path. Aiki can run that implementation recursively. Distribution and self-hosting have both been exercised away from the source-tree environment that originally sheltered them. The profiler has been calibrated from directly countable programs through recursive interpretation. There is plenty left to do, but this is a useful state to mark. sentences.en: An Independent Aiki Front End

blocks.html_en: The largest body of post-alpha work began with a question about self-description: how much of Aiki could be implemented independently in Aiki itself?

sentences.zh: 最大的 post-alpha 工作始于一个关于自我描述的问题：Aiki 有多少可以在 Aiki 本身中独立实现？

blocks.html_en: There is now an Aiki-written lexer, newline normalizer, and recursive-descent parser under selfhost/. They do not call the Go lexer or parser.

sentences.en: There is now an Aiki-written lexer, newline normalizer, and recursive-descent parser under selfhost/.

sentences.en: A lexer has to know the keywords and operators it recognizes.
sentences.zh: 词法分析器必须知道它识别的关键字和运算符。

sentences.en: A newline normalizer has to know the completion and suppression policy.

sentences.en: From Parser to Interpreter
sentences.zh: 从解析器到解释器

blocks.html_en: The independent front end then grew into an interpreter.

sentences.zh: 独立前端后来成长为解释器。

sentences.en: Aiki now has an Aiki-written runtime environment and evaluator supporting lexical lookup, shadowing, assignment into enclosing scopes, closures, recursion, rest parameters, lists, shapes, indexing, field access, statements, control flow, pattern matching, pipelines, and returns.
sentences.zh: Aiki 现在拥有 Aiki 编写的运行时环境和求值器，支持词法查找、遮蔽、赋值到封闭范围、闭包、递归、剩余参数、列表、形状、索引、字段访问、语句、控制流、模式匹配、管道和返回。

sentences.en: inside one, two, three, and four nested loops of ten.
sentences.zh: 在一个、两个、三个和四个十个嵌套循环内。

sentences.en: The leaf calculation therefore executes 10, 100, 1,000, and 10,000 times.
The total completed loop-body iterations are 10, 110, 1,110, and 11,110.
The profiler reports those counts exactly.
sentences.zh: 探查器准确地报告这些计数。

sentences.en: Arithmetic is equally direct.
sentences.zh: 算术同样直接。

sentences.en: Each leaf contributes one addition and each loop-body iteration increments one loop variable, so the expected arithmetic counts are 20, 210, 2,110, and 21,110.
sentences.zh: 每个叶子贡献一次加法，每次循环体迭代都会增加一个循环变量，因此预期算术计数为 20、210、2,110 和 21,110。

sentences.en: Those counts are exact as well.
sentences.zh: 这些计数也很准确。

sentences.en: The observed comparison sequence: 11, 121, 1,221, and 12,221, is also exactly what follows from testing each loop condition once more than its body executes.
sentences.zh: 观察到的比较序列：11、121、1,221 和 12,221，也正是在循环体执行一次后测试每个循环条件所得出的结果。

sentences.en: A simpler expression:
sentences.zh: 更简单的表达：

blocks.html_en: contains three arithmetic operations; the profiler reports three.

sentences.en: contains three arithmetic operations; the profiler reports three.
sentences.zh: 包含三个算术运算；探查器报告三个。

sentences.en: A conventional loop:
sentences.zh: 常规循环：

sentences.en: has the directly predictable relationships:
sentences.zh: 具有直接可预测的关系：

blocks.html_en: For N equal to 10, 100, and 1,000, the observed counts match all three relationships exactly.

sentences.en: For N equal to 10, 100, and 1,000, the observed counts match all three relationships exactly.
sentences.zh: 对于 N 等于 10、100 和 1,000，观察到的计数与所有三种关系完全匹配。

blocks.html_en: The experiment then moves into self-interpretation. With one Aiki-written interpreter loaded, one additional evaluation contributes:

sentences.en: The experiment then moves into self-interpretation.
sentences.zh: 然后实验进入自我解释。

sentences.en: With one Aiki-written interpreter loaded, one additional evaluation contributes:
sentences.zh: 加载一个 Aiki 编写的解释器后，一项额外的评估会贡献：

blocks.html_en: Two evaluations add exactly twice that work, and four add exactly four times that work.

sentences.en: Two evaluations add exactly twice that work, and four add exactly four times that work.
sentences.zh: 两次评估正好增加两倍的工作量，四次评估正好增加四倍的工作量。

blocks.html_en: At the next interpreter level the fixed baseline is already large:

sentences.en: At the next interpreter level the fixed baseline is already large:
sentences.zh: 在下一个解释器级别，固定基线已经很大：

sentences.en: One additional third-level evaluation then adds:
sentences.zh: 另一项第三级评估则添加：

blocks.html_en: and the next identical evaluation adds exactly the same vector.

sentences.en: and the next identical evaluation adds exactly the same vector.
sentences.zh: 下一个相同的评估会添加完全相同的向量。

blocks.html_en: I ran the complete experiment twice. Every semantic counter was reproduced exactly across the two runs, including the native, one-level, and two-level self-host cases. The Go realization figures: elapsed time, cumulative allocation traffic, malloc count, and garbage-collection cycles, varied modestly, as expected.

sentences.en: I ran the complete experiment twice.
sentences.zh: 我进行了两次完整的实验。

sentences.en: Every semantic counter was reproduced exactly across the two runs, including the native, one-level, and two-level self-host cases.
sentences.zh: 每个语义计数器在两次运行中都被准确地再现，包括本机、一级和两级自托管情况。

sentences.en: The Go realization figures: elapsed time, cumulative allocation traffic, malloc count, and garbage-collection cycles, varied modestly, as expected.
sentences.zh: Go 实现数据：经过的时间、累积分配流量、malloc 计数和垃圾收集周期，如预期的那样略有变化。

blocks.html_en: The distinction is important. The semantic counters describe Aiki-level work. The Go measurements describe a particular realization of that work by the runtime and machine.

sentences.en: The distinction is important.
sentences.zh: 区别很重要。

sentences.en: The semantic counters describe Aiki-level work.
sentences.zh: 语义计数器描述 Aiki 级别的工作。

sentences.en: The Go measurements describe a particular realization of that work by the runtime and machine.
sentences.zh: Go 测量描述了运行时和机器对该工作的特定实现。

blocks.html_en: The calibration therefore connects programs countable by inspection with recursive interpretation involving millions of semantic events. Large recursive profiler counts are not being accepted merely because they have plausible scale; they are produced by the same instrumentation that is exact on small source and additive under repeated interpreted work.

sentences.en: The calibration therefore connects programs countable by inspection with recursive interpretation involving millions of semantic events.
sentences.zh: 因此，校准将通过检查可计数的程序与涉及数百万个语义事件的递归解释连接起来。

sentences.en: Large recursive profiler counts are not being accepted merely because they have plausible scale; they are produced by the same instrumentation that is exact on small source and additive under repeated interpreted work.
sentences.zh: 大量的递归分析器计数并不仅仅因为它们具有合理的规模而被接受；它们是由相同的仪器在重复解释工作下使用小来源和添加剂精确生产的。

sentences.en: Experiments Are Not Tests
sentences.zh: 实验不是测试

blocks.html_en: That calibration became Experiment 001 and, in the process, exposed the need for another kind of project artifact.

sentences.en: That calibration became Experiment 001 and, in the process, exposed the need for another kind of project artifact.
sentences.zh: 该校准成为实验 001，并在此过程中暴露了对另一种项目工件的需求。

blocks.html_en: Tests and experiments answer different questions. A test normally states a relationship the implementation is required to preserve. An experiment records a procedure, an observation, and an interpretation without turning the observation into a correctness gold.

sentences.en: Tests and experiments answer different questions.
sentences.zh: 测试和实验回答不同的问题。

sentences.en: A test normally states a relationship the implementation is required to preserve.
sentences.zh: 测试通常会说明实现需要保留的关系。

sentences.en: An experiment records a procedure, an observation, and an interpretation without turning the observation into a correctness gold.
sentences.zh: 实验记录了一个过程、一个观察结果和一个解释，但没有将观察结果转化为正确性。

blocks.html_en: Aiki experiments therefore have a simple structure:

sentences.en: Aiki experiments therefore have a simple structure:
sentences.zh: 因此，Aiki 实验的结构很简单：

blocks.html_en: The root orients the reader. experiment/ records the procedure and its materials. results/ contains what happened. analyses/ contains what I think the observations mean.

sentences.en: The root orients the reader.
sentences.zh: 根源引导读者。

sentences.en: experiment/ records the procedure and its materials.
sentences.zh: 实验/记录程序及其材料。

sentences.en: results/ contains what happened.
sentences.zh: results/ 包含发生的事情。

sentences.en: analyses/ contains what I think the observations mean.
sentences.zh: 分析/包含我认为观察结果的含义。

blocks.html_en: New work can be scaffolded outside the source tree with:

sentences.en: New work can be scaffolded outside the source tree with:
sentences.zh: 新的工作可以在源代码树之外搭建：

blocks.html_en: The running distribution supplies the sequence number from its curated experiments/ collection, while the experiment itself is created in the caller's current directory. Finished work can then be promoted into the repository.

sentences.en: The running distribution supplies the sequence number from its curated experiments/ collection, while the experiment itself is created in the caller's current directory.
sentences.zh: 正在运行的发行版提供来自其策划的实验/集合的序列号，而实验本身是在调用者的当前目录中创建的。

sentences.en: Finished work can then be promoted into the repository.
sentences.zh: 然后可以将完成的工作提升到存储库中。

blocks.html_en: The distinction among procedure, observation, and interpretation is useful enough that I expect experiments to become a regular part of Aiki development.

sentences.en: The distinction among procedure, observation, and interpretation is useful enough that I expect experiments to become a regular part of Aiki development.
sentences.zh: 程序、观察和解释之间的区别非常有用，我希望实验能够成为 Aiki 开发的常规部分。

sentences.en: The Commitments
sentences.zh: 承诺

blocks.html_en: None of this changes the original commitments of the project.

sentences.en: None of this changes the original commitments of the project.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都不会改变该项目的原始承诺。

blocks.html_en: I still want Aiki to have a small surface and to make computational relationships visible enough to apprehend rather than merely execute. I still prefer direct composition over hidden machinery. The implementation still does not define the language merely by existing.

sentences.en: I still want Aiki to have a small surface and to make computational relationships visible enough to apprehend rather than merely execute.
sentences.zh: 我仍然希望 Aiki 有一个小表面，并使计算关系足够可见，以便于理解而不是仅仅执行。

sentences.en: I still prefer direct composition over hidden machinery.
sentences.zh: 与隐藏的机制相比，我仍然更喜欢直接构图。

sentences.en: The implementation still does not define the language merely by existing.
sentences.zh: 该实现仍然不能仅仅通过现有的来定义语言。

blocks.html_en: The extensive use of generative AI in the implementation makes this more important rather than less. The response is not to obscure that AI produced source code. It is to make the resulting source increasingly answerable to authorities and evidence outside itself.

sentences.en: The extensive use of generative AI in the implementation makes this more important rather than less.
sentences.zh: 生成式人工智能在实施中的广泛使用使得这一点变得更加重要而不是不那么重要。

sentences.en: The response is not to obscure that AI produced source code.
sentences.zh: 回应并不是要掩盖人工智能产生源代码的事实。

sentences.en: It is to make the resulting source increasingly answerable to authorities and evidence outside itself.
sentences.zh: 这是为了使最终的来源越来越对外界的权威和证据负责。

blocks.html_en: The grammar owns syntax facts. Reviewed behavior constrains semantics. Executable documentation constrains examples. The language surface constrains implementation choices. Independent implementations can be compared. Editor clients exercise the service boundary. Relocated distributions test assumptions about location. Experiments retain their observations beside the procedure that produced them.

sentences.en: The grammar owns syntax facts.
sentences.zh: 语法拥有语法事实。

sentences.en: Reviewed behavior constrains semantics.
sentences.zh: 审查的行为限制语义。

sentences.en: Executable documentation constrains examples.
sentences.zh: 可执行文档限制示例。

sentences.en: The language surface constrains implementation choices.
sentences.zh: 语言表面限制了实现选择。

sentences.en: Independent implementations can be compared.
sentences.zh: 可以比较独立的实现。

sentences.en: Editor clients exercise the service boundary.
sentences.zh: 编辑器客户行使服务边界。

sentences.en: Relocated distributions test assumptions about location.
sentences.zh: 重新安置的分布测试有关位置的假设。

sentences.en: Experiments retain their observations beside the procedure that produced them.
sentences.zh: 实验将观察结果保留在产生观察结果的程序之外。

blocks.html_en: The direction is toward fewer places where an implementation assumption can quietly become a language fact.

sentences.en: The direction is toward fewer places where an implementation assumption can quietly become a language fact.
sentences.zh: 方向是减少实现假设可以悄然成为语言事实的地方。

sentences.en: Platforms
sentences.zh: 平台

blocks.html_en: Linux remains Aiki's development home. That is where it is built, changed, and exercised continuously.

sentences.en: Linux remains Aiki's development home.
sentences.zh: Linux 仍然是 Aiki 的开发基地。

sentences.en: That is where it is built, changed, and exercised continuously.
sentences.zh: 这就是它不断构建、改变和运用的地方。

blocks.html_en: Intel macOS is periodically put through the more rigorous build and validation path rather than being assumed portable merely because it compiles. Windows is also run periodically and remains part of the portability work, although neither platform receives the continuous development attention that Linux does.

sentences.en: Intel macOS is periodically put through the more rigorous build and validation path rather than being assumed portable merely because it compiles.
sentences.zh: 英特尔 macOS 会定期通过更严格的构建和验证路径，而不是仅仅因为它可以编译而被认为是可移植的。

sentences.en: Windows is also run periodically and remains part of the portability work, although neither platform receives the continuous development attention that Linux does.
sentences.zh: Windows 也会定期运行，并且仍然是可移植性工作的一部分，尽管这两个平台都没有像 Linux 那样受到持续开发的关注。

blocks.html_en: Aiki is cross-platform alpha software, developed primarily on Linux.

sentences.en: Aiki is cross-platform alpha software, developed primarily on Linux.
sentences.zh: Aiki 是跨平台 alpha 软件，主要在 Linux 上开发。

sentences.en: Pending Work
sentences.zh: 待处理的工作

blocks.html_en: The authority work made several unresolved language questions easier to see. Newline behavior still has intentionally deferred edges, including the treatment of some leading continuations and the special case around function-literal endings. Those are now explicit language-design questions rather than accidental parser rules.

sentences.en: The authority work made several unresolved language questions easier to see.
sentences.zh: 权威工作使一些未解决的语言问题更容易被看到。

sentences.en: Newline behavior still has intentionally deferred edges, including the treatment of some leading continuations and the special case around function-literal endings.
sentences.zh: 换行行为仍然具有故意延迟的边缘，包括对一些前导延续的处理以及围绕函数字面量结尾的特殊情况。

sentences.en: Those are now explicit language-design questions rather than accidental parser rules.
sentences.zh: 这些现在是明确的语言设计问题，而不是偶然的解析器规则。

blocks.html_en: The language-service architecture is also deliberately incomplete. Incremental parsing, workspace-wide indexing, semantic tokens, rename/refactoring, and similar facilities are possible extensions, but they are not requirements merely because LSP has names for them. I would rather add them when actual use shows where the simpler model is inadequate.

sentences.en: The language-service architecture is also deliberately incomplete.
sentences.zh: 语言服务架构也故意不完整。

sentences.en: Incremental parsing, workspace-wide indexing, semantic tokens, rename/refactoring, and similar facilities are possible extensions, but they are not requirements merely because LSP has names for them.
sentences.zh: 增量解析、工作区范围的索引、语义标记、重命名/重构和类似的功能都是可能的扩展，但它们并不是仅仅因为 LSP 有名称而要求的。

sentences.en: I would rather add them when actual use shows where the simpler model is inadequate.
sentences.zh: 当实际使用表明更简单的模型不够充分时，我宁愿添加它们。

blocks.html_en: Spawned abnormal termination needs further thought as well. Aiki's concurrency model makes isolation and message passing explicit; failure of spawned computations should have equally explicit observable semantics rather than becoming a leak from the Go substrate.

sentences.en: Spawned abnormal termination needs further thought as well.
sentences.zh: 产生的异常终止也需要进一步考虑。

sentences.en: Aiki's concurrency model makes isolation and message passing explicit; failure of spawned computations should have equally explicit observable semantics rather than becoming a leak from the Go substrate.
sentences.zh: Aiki 的并发模型使隔离和消息传递变得明确；衍生计算的失败应该具有同样明确的可观察语义，而不是成为 Go 底层的泄漏。

blocks.html_en: The broader project record now distinguishes proposals, audit findings, design decisions, experiments, bugs, and implementation sessions. I expect to continue using those distinctions rather than turning every open question into an implementation task.

sentences.en: The broader project record now distinguishes proposals, audit findings, design decisions, experiments, bugs, and implementation sessions.
sentences.zh: 现在，更广泛的项目记录区分了提案、审计结果、设计决策、实验、错误和实施会话。

sentences.en: I expect to continue using those distinctions rather than turning every open question into an implementation task.
sentences.zh: 我希望继续利用这些区别，而不是将每个悬而未决的问题转化为实施任务。

sentences.en: Future Direction
sentences.zh: 未来方向

blocks.html_en: The architectural direction is to continue tightening responsibilities and authorities: make each fact, capability, and policy belong somewhere definite; derive rather than duplicate where possible; and make important relationships executable.

sentences.en: The architectural direction is to continue tightening responsibilities and authorities: make each fact, capability, and policy belong somewhere definite; derive rather than duplicate where possible; and make important relationships executable.
sentences.zh: 架构方向是继续收紧责任和权限：让每一个事实、能力、政策都有明确的归属；尽可能衍生而不是复制；并使重要的关系变得可执行。

blocks.html_en: The next capability work is likely to concentrate on the systems substrate.

sentences.en: The next capability work is likely to concentrate on the systems substrate.
sentences.zh: 下一个能力工作可能会集中在系统底层上。

sentences.en: Process Execution
sentences.zh: 流程执行

blocks.html_en: I expect to start with process execution. A useful interface needs to launch a program with arguments, standard input, environment, and working directory, and return standard output, standard error, and exit status.

sentences.en: I expect to start with process execution.
sentences.zh: 我希望从流程执行开始。

sentences.en: A useful interface needs to launch a program with arguments, standard input, environment, and working directory, and return standard output, standard error, and exit status.
sentences.zh: 一个有用的接口需要启动带有参数、标准输入、环境和工作目录的程序，并返回标准输出、标准错误和退出状态。

blocks.html_en: The host operation is narrow and belongs below the HAL boundary. Process orchestration belongs in Aiki. This is a small addition with a large practical effect because it allows Aiki programs to compose ordinary system tools.

sentences.en: The host operation is narrow and belongs below the HAL boundary.
sentences.zh: 主机操作范围较窄，属于 HAL 边界以下。

sentences.en: Process orchestration belongs in Aiki.
sentences.zh: 流程编排属于 Aiki。

sentences.en: This is a small addition with a large practical effect because it allows Aiki programs to compose ordinary system tools.
sentences.zh: 这是一个小补充，但实际效果很大，因为它允许 Aiki 程序组成普通的系统工具。

sentences.en: Networking
sentences.zh: 联网

blocks.html_en: TCP requires a similarly small host surface: listen, accept, connect, read, write, and close.

sentences.en: TCP requires a similarly small host surface: listen, accept, connect, read, write, and close.
sentences.zh: TCP 需要一个类似的小主机表面：监听、接受、连接、读取、写入和关闭。

blocks.html_en: Aiki already has isolated spawn, channels, and message passing. A concurrent server should be constructed by composing those facilities with networking rather than by adding a separate server model.

sentences.en: Aiki already has isolated spawn, channels, and message passing.
sentences.zh: Aiki 已经具有隔离的生成、通道和消息传递。

sentences.en: A concurrent server should be constructed by composing those facilities with networking rather than by adding a separate server model.
sentences.zh: 并发服务器应该通过将这些设施与网络组合起来来构建，而不是通过添加单独的服务器模型来构建。

blocks.html_en: JSON should be largely an Aiki library. The self-host lexer has already demonstrated character-level scanning, and Aiki values map reasonably well onto JSON values. A parser and emitter written in Aiki would be another useful test of where the HAL boundary belongs.

sentences.en: JSON should be largely an Aiki library.
sentences.zh: JSON 很大程度上应该是一个 Aiki 库。

sentences.en: The self-host lexer has already demonstrated character-level scanning, and Aiki values map reasonably well onto JSON values.
sentences.zh: 自托管词法分析器已经演示了字符级扫描，并且 Aiki 值可以很好地映射到 JSON 值。

sentences.en: A parser and emitter written in Aiki would be another useful test of where the HAL boundary belongs.
sentences.zh: 用 Aiki 编写的解析器和发射器将是 HAL 边界所属位置的另一个有用测试。

sentences.en: Operating-System Surface
sentences.zh: 操作系统界面

blocks.html_en: A systems environment also needs ordinary process facts: arguments, environment variables, current directory, directory change, exit status, process ID, hostname, and related information.

sentences.en: A systems environment also needs ordinary process facts: arguments, environment variables, current directory, directory change, exit status, process ID, hostname, and related information.
sentences.zh: 系统环境还需要普通的进程事实：参数、环境变量、当前目录、目录更改、退出状态、进程 ID、主机名和相关信息。

blocks.html_en: I expect these to be a collection of small HAL capabilities behind an Aiki os module rather than additions scattered through the prelude.

sentences.en: I expect these to be a collection of small HAL capabilities behind an Aiki os module rather than additions scattered through the prelude.
sentences.zh: 我希望这些是 Aiki os 模块背后的小型 HAL 功能的集合，而不是分散在前奏中的附加功能。

sentences.en: Signals
sentences.zh: 信号

blocks.html_en: Signal handling has to fit the concurrency model. My present direction is for signals such as SIGINT and SIGTERM to arrive as channel events, allowing ordinary message passing and select to coordinate them instead of introducing an unrelated asynchronous control mechanism.

sentences.en: Signal handling has to fit the concurrency model.
sentences.zh: 信号处理必须适合并发模型。

sentences.en: My present direction is for signals such as SIGINT and SIGTERM to arrive as channel events, allowing ordinary message passing and select to coordinate them instead of introducing an unrelated asynchronous control mechanism.
sentences.zh: 我目前的方向是让 SIGINT 和 SIGTERM 等信号作为通道事件到达，允许普通的消息传递和选择来协调它们，而不是引入不相关的异步控制机制。

sentences.en: Timers
sentences.zh: 定时器

blocks.html_en: Wall-clock time, elapsed time, and sleeping are straightforward host facilities. Timed coordination should compose with concurrency; time.after naturally fits the existing select design.

sentences.en: Wall-clock time, elapsed time, and sleeping are straightforward host facilities.
sentences.zh: 挂钟时间、经过时间和睡眠是简单的主机设施。

sentences.en: Timed coordination should compose with concurrency; time.after naturally fits the existing select design.
sentences.zh: 定时协调应与并发相结合； time.after 自然适合现有的 select 设计。

sentences.en: Cryptographic Hashing
sentences.zh: 加密散列

blocks.html_en: SHA-256 and HMAC are another relatively clean boundary and become useful once programs begin dealing with integrity or authentication.

sentences.en: SHA-256 and HMAC are another relatively clean boundary and become useful once programs begin dealing with integrity or authentication.
sentences.zh: SHA-256 和 HMAC 是另一个相对清晰的边界，一旦程序开始处理完整性或身份验证，它们就会变得有用。

blocks.html_en: Across these additions the question remains the same: what is the smallest thing the host must provide, and what can Aiki construct from it?

sentences.en: Across these additions the question remains the same: what is the smallest thing the host must provide, and what can Aiki construct from it?
sentences.zh: 在这些添加中，问题仍然是相同的：主机必须提供的最小的东西是什么，Aiki 可以从中构建什么？

sentences.en: Aiki at v0.4.0-alpha-26
sentences.zh: Aiki v0.4.0-alpha-26

blocks.html_en: Much of the work since the first alpha is architectural rather than immediately visible at the prompt. The following is a compact inventory of the tagged system.

sentences.en: Much of the work since the first alpha is architectural rather than immediately visible at the prompt.
sentences.zh: 自第一个 alpha 版本以来，大部分工作都是架构性的，而不是在提示时立即可见。

sentences.en: The following is a compact inventory of the tagged system.
sentences.zh: 以下是标记系统的紧凑清单。

sentences.en: Language
sentences.zh: 语言

sentences.en: exact rational arithmetic;

content_html_zh:
最近和Aiki很忙，这几天特别活跃。 下周我回到我的日常工作。 我是塔尔顿州立大学的计算机信息系统教授。 所以，我一直利用剩下的暑假时间来关闭几件相关的工作。

当前状态标记为 v0.4.0-alpha-26。 我不打算为每个这样的点创建一个 GitHub 版本。 master 随着开发的继续而移动；标签标记值得停留的状态。

第一个公共 alpha 版本已经包含了大部分语言本身：精确有理算术、从左到右求值、一流函数、递归和迭代、管道、成形数据、模块、可恢复错误、隔离并发、图形、标准库、语义分析、可执行文档、行为黄金、语法覆盖率和实质性不变框架。 此后的大部分工作并没有太大程度地扩大这个表面。 它使其之下的关系变得更加严格。

权威与语法

第一个实质性的 post-alpha 工作是换行符处理。 Grammar.ebnfx 描述了产生式，但部分实际表面规则仍然存在于解析器代码中：物理换行符是否终止语句取决于私有完成集和分隔符抑制逻辑。 该政策现在已经存在于语法中。 解析器使用它，帮助公开它，并且结构分析得出它的结果。

这暴露了有关现有语言的一些有用的事实。 一些最初看起来像是有问题的延续的标记：(、[ 和 -，实际上在终止后被解析为新表达式的开始。 其他延续被当前规则明确阻止。 以 } 结尾的函数文字暴露了另一个边缘，因为 } 可以结束表达式，而其本身不属于换行完成集的一部分。 我改变这些语言选择不仅仅是为了使规则更加对称。 它们现在是可见的设计问题，而不是隐藏在解析器代码中的行为。

同一项工作加强了几个语法敏感的关系。 评估器覆盖范围根据语法实际可以生成的语法进行检查。 格式化程序覆盖在整个语法中是明确的，而不是通过静默递归来实现。 检查有关语法节点的 Linter 知识。 二元运算符成员资格来自语法而不是单独的评估器列表。 换行帮助和相关诊断源自已声明的策略。

然后第二遍发现几个消费者独立地使用语法来得出相同的结构事实。 这些推导现在集中在缓存的语法分析中。 产品名称、令牌引用、AST 生成节点类型、终端替代方案和换行符分析一次性导出并在需要时使用。

工作规则很简单：一个事实应该有一个权威。 消费者可能有自己的政策和代表，但他们不应该独立地重建同一事实。

工具和故障语义

新线工作故意引入了无法解析的烟雾样本，这暴露了周围工具的一些弱点。 否定解析器样本现在明确声明自己：

# @negative parse

该声明仅限于有意义的测试装置。 它不能在普通源中使用来免除格式错误的代码的格式化或 linting。

随后发现了几个老问题。 递归格式化可能会遇到格式错误的源，报告它，但仍然无法正确传播错误。 Lint 的格式化预检可能会在第一个格式错误的文件后停止。 多个命令在内部返回顶级可执行文件丢弃的状态代码，从而允许命令打印失败并仍然成功退出。

这些路径现在将其状态传播到 shell。

更全面的 lint 遍历还暴露了单独的模块分辨率漂移。 运行时通过模块注册表解析公共包名称，而 lint 维护该规则的文件系统近似值。 一旦 lint 开始到达之前跳过的源代码，使用 use("list") 的有效代码就足以暴露分歧。 Lint 现在使用相同的注册表模型进行公共包解析，同时保留路径导入的正常相对路径处理。

我对语法项目进行了更全面的审核，并开始用稳定的标识符和明确的处置记录结果。 有些是固定的，有些是接受的，有些是推迟的。 例如，换行符抑制现在跟踪预期的结束定界符，而不是不匹配的结束符可能破坏的聚合深度。 分类账的目的不是将每一次观察转化为工作；而是将其转化为工作。这是为了防止项目结束时可信的发现消失。

分布和位置独立性

Aiki 还积累了一个隐含的假设，即源树就是安装。

这是有效的，因为开发可执行文件通常位于 lib/ 旁边，但这意味着运行时正确性部分取决于进程启动的位置。 正在运行的可执行文件现在可以识别其发行版。 已发布的模块是相对于该可执行文件找到的，用户模块具有明确的主目录，并且命名包发现不会递归扫描当前工作目录下的任意树。

因此，正常的安装模型就是：

unpack Aiki
add the directory to PATH
run aiki

make dist 构建用户分布。 make distcheck 更进一步：它在临时前缀下解压该发行版，从不相关的目录运行，在那里植入误导性的包树，并验证已安装的 Aiki 是否仍然可以正确解析并运行其自己的模块。

开发快照还有一个单独的 make 基线目标。 基线保留存储库，包括 .git，并旨在作为完整的可重新启动的开发状态。 这不是用户分布。

这种区别后来在自托管期间再次变得重要。 事实证明，在存储库根目录中起作用的一些事情取决于其所在位置。

独立的 Aiki 前端

最大的 post-alpha 工作始于一个关于自我描述的问题：Aiki 有多少可以在 Aiki 本身中独立实现？

现在 selfhost/ 下有一个 Aiki 编写的词法分析器、换行规范化器和递归下降解析器。 他们不调用 Go 词法分析器或解析器。

独立性确实需要重复一些事实。 词法分析器必须知道它识别的关键字和运算符。 换行规范化器必须知道完成和抑制策略。 这些重复的事实将根据从 Grammar.ebnfx 派生的值进行检查；算法本身保持独立。

根据经过审查的一致性预测，将词法和换行实现与 Go 实现进行比较。 对于解析，我重用了现有的语法形解析黄金，而不是发明另一种预期树格式。 结果是语法和审查证据、Go 实现和 Aiki 实现之间建立了有用的三向关系。

这与简单地围绕同一实现添加更多测试不同。 第二个前端有自己的代码和自己出错的机会。

语言服务

编辑工作也源于对权威的同样关注。

解析器、格式化程序、linter、编辑器扩展和 LSP 服务器很容易成为该语言的几个不完整的副本。 我没有让 LSP 服务器成为 Aiki 语义的另一个所有者，而是将可重用的语言知识转移到独立于编辑器的服务层中。

该层现在提供文档分析、结构化诊断、符号、定义查找、规范格式、完成和悬停信息。 aiki lsp 是该服务的适配器，而不是服务本身。

这是通过三位截然不同的编辑来实现的。 Xed 使用其正常的 GtkSourceView 机制进行词汇呈现，并使用一个瘦插件进行实时诊断。 VS Code 使用传统的瘦语言客户端，并已针对诊断、完成、悬停、转到定义和格式化文档进行了测试。 对于 nvi，Aiki 生成普通标签：

aiki tags -o tags source.ai

nvi 以通常的方式使用它们。

实时编辑器测试很有用。 Xed 暴露了另存为文档标识和零宽度 EOF 诊断的呈现。 VS Code 暴露了无效的 JSON-RPC null 响应，并假设定义请求将位于标识符的第一个字节。 桌面启动的编辑器还证明，无法从交互式 shell 的 PATH 推断出它们的进程环境。

这些是适配器问题，而不是邀请将 Aiki 语义转移到适配器中。

从解析器到解释器

独立前端后来成长为解释器。

Aiki 现在拥有 Aiki 编写的运行时环境和求值器，支持词法查找、遮蔽、赋值到封闭范围、闭包、递归、剩余参数、列表、形状、索引、字段访问、语句、控制流、模式匹配、管道和返回。

这项工作暴露了语言表面的两个缺口。

解析器可以读取任意符号文字，但普通 Aiki 没有从字符串构造任意本机符号的操作。 因此，如果不维护有限的私有符号表或引入自己的替代表示，自托管解释器就无法忠实地将源词位转换为相应的值。 两者都不可接受。

结果是：

to_symbol("foo")

产生 :foo.

成形值暴露了相关的边界。 基板已经知道如何构建它们，但普通的 Aiki 却不知道。 那变成了：

shaped(:point, [1, 2])

这些都是对该语言的小补充，但它们来自一个有用的标准：用 Aiki 编写的 Aiki 实现不应需要普通 Aiki 源可以表达的值的私有表示。

模块和 HAL 边界

模块需要类似的决定。

对于自托管评估器来说，将 import() 委托回主机解释器是很容易的，但这也会将源模块语义委托给正在检查的实现。 因此，自托管路径会自行执行 Aiki 源模块加载：

resolve
read
lex
normalize
parse
evaluate
collect exports
cache

平台设施仍保留主机功能。 特权引导程序捕获受祝福的库模块所需的 HAL 函数，并将它们安装到解释库环境中，而不会将这些原始绑定暴露给普通调用者。

这种区别是有意为之的。 Aiki 源语义可以在 Aiki 中实现。 文件访问、时钟、图形、本机正则表达式和其他平台效果仍然必须来自底层。

行为一致性

通过独立评估者运行现有的行为样本，发现了更集中的评估者测试所遗漏的语义错误。

Aiki 可恢复错误，例如：

[@error, :math, "division by zero"]

是普通值。 它们可以被装订、退回、检查和匹配。

自托管评估器最初使用 is_error() 来识别其自身的内部故障，从而将可恢复的 Aiki 值与评估器停止混为一谈。 解释器现在为自己的控制路径使用单独的私有故障表示，留下 [@error, ...] 可恢复的价值。

行为一致性工作现在涵盖代表性算术、闭包和递归、匹配、管道、相对导入、字符串、文件效果、纯和 HAL 支持的模块、字节、哈希、正则表达式行为和其他现有语言样本。 并发、图形、仅限调试器的情况和交互式 I/O 仍然在当前的自托管证明之外，而不是被默默地算作涵盖范围。

递归自我解释

最终目标是运行一个 Aiki 编写的解释器。

第一次尝试似乎花费了大部分时间来解析内部解析器，这表明树行走解释器下的递归下降解析是主要问题。 语义剖析却显示出相反的情况。 很大一部分成本在于独立词法分析器的字符处理：重复的字符串索引导致大型源字符串上的重复符文具体化。

string.chars 现在具有线性基底实现，并且自主机词法分析器对源进行一次快照，并避免了一些重复的表扫描和定位工作。 这减少了测量的工作量，足以暴露下一个问题。

这些是模块问题而不是解析器问题。 独立加载程序中的路径回退与主机加载程序不太匹配。 涉及不同的路径。 和 .. 可以命名相同的物理模块，但成为单独的缓存条目。 从存储库外部递归运行然后暴露了进一步的假设：自托管加载器需要访问与主机加载器相同的有序分发模块根。

这些都得到了纠正，而没有将内部解析器或评估器交还给 Go。

结果路径现在可以工作：

Go-hosted Aiki
    -> Aiki-written interpreter
        -> self-host-loaded Aiki interpreter
            -> 1 + 2 * 3
                -> 9

结果是 9，因为普通 Aiki 二进制表达式是从左到右计算的：(1 + 2) * 3。 同样的可见语义规则在第三层仍然存在。

Go 仍然是生产运行时和引导底层。 自主机实现是第二个实现和一致性边界，而不是试图假装底层机器或主机运行时已经消失。

分析分析器

语义分析已经存在于第一个 alpha 版本中。 在自托管工作期间，它变得足够有用，以至于测量本身值得仔细审查。

递归配置文件很大。 我并没有因为它们看起来合理而接受它们，而是建立了一个校准实验，从可以直接从 Aiki 的几行代码中读取语义计数的工作开始。

第一个程序放置：

1 + 1

在一个、两个、三个和四个十个嵌套循环内。 因此，叶子计算执行 10、100、1,000 和 10,000 次。 完成的循环体迭代总数为 10、110、1,110 和 11,110。 探查器准确地报告这些计数。

算术同样直接。 每个叶子贡献一次加法，每次循环体迭代都会增加一个循环变量，因此预期算术计数为 20、210、2,110 和 21,110。 这些计数也很准确。 观察到的比较序列：11、121、1,221 和 12,221，也正是在循环体执行一次后测试每个循环条件所得出的结果。

更简单的表达：

1 + 2 + 3 + 4

包含三个算术运算；探查器报告三个。

常规循环：

while i < N {
    x = x + 1
    i = i + 1
}

具有直接可预测的关系：

arithmetic = 2N
comparison = N + 1
iteration  = N

对于 N 等于 10、100 和 1,000，观察到的计数与所有三种关系完全匹配。

然后实验进入自我解释。 加载一个 Aiki 编写的解释器后，一项额外的评估会贡献：

arithmetic       958
comparison      1,082
call            3,255
iteration         832
index             935

两次评估正好增加两倍的工作量，四次评估正好增加四倍的工作量。

在下一个解释器级别，固定基线已经很大：

arithmetic       689,681
comparison     1,346,671
call           5,021,109
iteration        498,039
index            793,179

另一项第三级评估则添加：

arithmetic      +353,930
comparison      +388,932
call          +2,342,216
iteration       +304,091
index           +397,156

下一个相同的评估会添加完全相同的向量。

我进行了两次完整的实验。 每个语义计数器在两次运行中都被准确地再现，包括本机、一级和两级自托管情况。 Go 实现数据：经过的时间、累积分配流量、malloc 计数和垃圾收集周期，如预期的那样略有变化。

区别很重要。 语义计数器描述 Aiki 级别的工作。 Go 测量描述了运行时和机器对该工作的特定实现。

因此，校准将通过检查可计数的程序与涉及数百万个语义事件的递归解释连接起来。 大量的递归分析器计数并不仅仅因为它们具有合理的规模而被接受；它们是由相同的仪器在重复解释工作下使用小来源和添加剂精确生产的。

实验不是测试

该校准成为实验 001，并在此过程中暴露了对另一种项目工件的需求。

测试和实验回答不同的问题。 测试通常会说明实现需要保留的关系。 实验记录了一个过程、一个观察结果和一个解释，但没有将观察结果转化为正确性。

因此，Aiki 实验的结构很简单：

001-profiler-calibration/
    README.md

    experiment/
        PROCEDURE.md
        run.sh
        materials...

    results/
        observations...

    analyses/
        interpretations...

根源引导读者。 实验/记录程序及其材料。 results/ 包含发生的事情。 分析/包含我认为观察结果的含义。

新的工作可以在源代码树之外搭建：

aiki experiment new "name"

正在运行的发行版提供来自其策划的实验/集合的序列号，而实验本身是在调用者的当前目录中创建的。 然后可以将完成的工作提升到存储库中。

程序、观察和解释之间的区别非常有用，我希望实验能够成为 Aiki 开发的常规部分。

承诺

所有这些都不会改变该项目的原始承诺。

我仍然希望 Aiki 有一个小表面，并使计算关系足够可见，以便于理解而不是仅仅执行。 与隐藏的机制相比，我仍然更喜欢直接构图。 该实现仍然不能仅仅通过现有的来定义语言。

生成式人工智能在实施中的广泛使用使得这一点变得更加重要而不是不那么重要。 回应并不是要掩盖人工智能产生源代码的事实。 这是为了使最终的来源越来越对外界的权威和证据负责。

语法拥有语法事实。 审查的行为限制语义。 可执行文档限制示例。 语言表面限制了实现选择。 可以比较独立的实现。 编辑器客户行使服务边界。 重新安置的分布测试有关位置的假设。 实验将观察结果保留在产生观察结果的程序之外。

方向是减少实现假设可以悄然成为语言事实的地方。

平台

Linux 仍然是 Aiki 的开发基地。 这就是它不断构建、改变和运用的地方。

英特尔 macOS 会定期通过更严格的构建和验证路径，而不是仅仅因为它可以编译而被认为是可移植的。 Windows 也会定期运行，并且仍然是可移植性工作的一部分，尽管这两个平台都没有像 Linux 那样受到持续开发的关注。

Aiki 是跨平台 alpha 软件，主要在 Linux 上开发。

待处理的工作

权威工作使一些未解决的语言问题更容易被看到。 换行行为仍然具有故意延迟的边缘，包括对一些前导延续的处理以及围绕函数字面量结尾的特殊情况。 这些现在是明确的语言设计问题，而不是偶然的解析器规则。

语言服务架构也故意不完整。 增量解析、工作区范围的索引、语义标记、重命名/重构和类似的功能都是可能的扩展，但它们并不是仅仅因为 LSP 有名称而要求的。 当实际使用表明更简单的模型不够充分时，我宁愿添加它们。

产生的异常终止也需要进一步考虑。 Aiki 的并发模型使隔离和消息传递变得明确；衍生计算的失败应该具有同样明确的可观察语义，而不是成为 Go 底层的泄漏。

现在，更广泛的项目记录区分了提案、审计结果、设计决策、实验、错误和实施会话。 我希望继续利用这些区别，而不是将每个悬而未决的问题转化为实施任务。

未来方向

架构方向是继续收紧责任和权限：让每一个事实、能力、政策都有明确的归属；尽可能衍生而不是复制；并使重要的关系变得可执行。

下一个能力工作可能会集中在系统底层上。

流程执行

我希望从流程执行开始。 一个有用的接口需要启动带有参数、标准输入、环境和工作目录的程序，并返回标准输出、标准错误和退出状态。

主机操作范围较窄，属于 HAL 边界以下。 流程编排属于 Aiki。 这是一个小补充，但实际效果很大，因为它允许 Aiki 程序组成普通的系统工具。

联网

TCP 需要一个类似的小主机表面：监听、接受、连接、读取、写入和关闭。

Aiki 已经具有隔离的生成、通道和消息传递。 并发服务器应该通过将这些设施与网络组合起来来构建，而不是通过添加单独的服务器模型来构建。

JSON

JSON 很大程度上应该是一个 Aiki 库。 自托管词法分析器已经演示了字符级扫描，并且 Aiki 值可以很好地映射到 JSON 值。 用 Aiki 编写的解析器和发射器将是 HAL 边界所属位置的另一个有用测试。

操作系统界面

系统环境还需要普通的进程事实：参数、环境变量、当前目录、目录更改、退出状态、进程 ID、主机名和相关信息。

我希望这些是 Aiki os 模块背后的小型 HAL 功能的集合，而不是分散在前奏中的附加功能。

信号

信号处理必须适合并发模型。 我目前的方向是让 SIGINT 和 SIGTERM 等信号作为通道事件到达，允许普通的消息传递和选择来协调它们，而不是引入不相关的异步控制机制。

定时器

挂钟时间、经过时间和睡眠是简单的主机设施。 定时协调应与并发相结合； time.after 自然适合现有的 select 设计。

加密散列

SHA-256 和 HMAC 是另一个相对清晰的边界，一旦程序开始处理完整性或身份验证，它们就会变得有用。

在这些添加中，问题仍然是相同的：主机必须提供的最小的东西是什么，Aiki 可以从中构建什么？
